switch.title: Switch CLI
switch.generating: Asking current CLI for a summary…
switch.hint: The summary is injected as context into the new CLI's first message. Task history is kept.

modelSwitch.warningBody: The current conversation history contains image/video attachments. Switching to a non-multimodal model will cause a request error (Model only support text input). Please start a new task to use this model.
modelSwitch.newTaskHint: Clicking the button below creates a new task with this model selected. The current task is kept unchanged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.closeBehaviorDesc: Behavior when clicking the window close button
settings.closeActionDesc: Choose whether to quit directly or minimize to system tray
settings.cliPathsDesc: Override CLI executable paths; leave empty to auto-detect from PATH
settings.kimiShowThinkingHint: When enabled, kimi uses text output mode so thinking content is captured; tool calls render as simplified text. Off by default (better tool cards). Note: GBK mojibake in Windows command output is unrecoverable byte loss; the system-level fix is enabling "Beta: Unicode UTF-8" in Region settings (requires reboot).
settings.kimiUseAcpHint: ACP persistent-connection mode: token-level streaming, thinking process, and live tool progress. Disable to fall back to per-message headless invocation.
settings.notificationsHint: Show system notifications for approval requests and task completion (when unfocused); click to focus.

auth.loginHint: Login opens a system terminal window. Finish the interactive login there, then click "Refresh status".
auth.keyOnlyHint: This CLI supports API key authentication only (no official login command). Paste your API key above and save; the key is encrypted via system DPAPI.
auth.storageNotice: In-app keys are encrypted with Windows DPAPI (safeStorage) and stored locally; only the current OS user can decrypt them.
auth.membershipUnsupported: Membership/quota info is unavailable (the CLI provides no local query API)
auth.qwenLoginHint: Note: Qwen OAuth browser login was discontinued on 2026-04-15 (per official docs). Use a Coding Plan API key instead — paste it above and save (recommended, no login needed), or click "Login…" to open a terminal and choose "Alibaba ModelStudio → Coding Plan" under /auth.

models.hint: Manage third-party model providers for CLIs to call (like CC Switch).
models.listHint: Add third-party model provider endpoints here. Picking one in chat routes to its endpoint. CLI built-in official models are not managed here — just pick "CLI default" in chat.
models.emptyHint: No models yet. Click "Add model" to create one.
models.routeHint: Add third-party model provider endpoints here. Picking a model routes to its endpoint automatically. Keys are encrypted with OS DPAPI.

skills.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
skills.unsupportedNote: Only Kimi Code CLI and Claude Code support skills; Gemini / Codex have no such mechanism.
skills.templatesHint: One-click create as a user-level skill; editable after creation.

mcp.name: Name
mcp.hint: Changes are written to the CLI config file and take effect in new sessions; other fields are preserved.
mcp.presetsHint: Click to load the edit form, confirm params (replace angle-bracket placeholders) and save.

effort.title: Think
effort.followsModel: Thinking effort for this CLI follows the model / global config; per-task override is not supported
effort.unsupported: This CLI does not support thinking effort settings
effort.kimiNote: Applied by temporarily writing kimi global config; affects only this invocation

provider.title: Provider
provider.hint: Route the CLI through Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible endpoints from other vendors (CC Switch equivalent). Pick a preset, save its API key, and new messages go through that endpoint.
provider.priorityNote: Priority: provider preset > in-app key > system env vars. Detected external configs (e.g. settings.json written by CC Switch) show as "External" and are never overwritten.

usage.estimatedNote: Methodology: claude reports real token usage from the CLI; kimi and others are estimates (including thinking and tool blocks, weighted by character range: ASCII ~4 chars/token, CJK ~1.3 chars/token), for reference only.
usage.emptyState: No usage data yet. Start a conversation to see stats here.

context.label: Context
context.estimated: Context usage is a weighted estimate (CJK ~1.3 chars/token, ASCII ~4 chars/token), for reference only
